government_portal_signed_pdf.notice: The .signed.pdf government-portal transport is expected to contain at least one embedded PDF signature. A valid byte-range/CMS signature and a trusted certificate chain are separate findings.

official_journal_pdf.notice: Official Journal publication identity is enforced by official transport plus pinned bytes; an embedded PDF signature is not required by this repository policy.

official_secretariat_pdf.notice: Secretariat publication identity is enforced by official transport plus pinned bytes; an embedded PDF signature is not required by this repository policy.

external_deposit.notice: The repository can build and verify a deposit-ready package. It must not claim durable external custody until an owner-selected provider returns a verified persistent receipt.
